groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: wet things and what water does.

chars.story: Water works its way in through every crack: it seeps.
chars.note: Traditional 滲: the right-hand part was simplified.

chars.story: Water washes the lesser grains away: they are eliminated.
Water pours down through a forest of branches: you are drenched.
chars.note: In 冰淇淋 'ice cream' it is just part of a borrowed word.

chars.story: Water poured over you to wash you clean: a bath.
Water run through a screen: filtered.
chars.note: Traditional 濾: the right-hand part was simplified to 虑.

chars.story: A sheet of water spreading as far as you can see: vast.
chars.note: Often doubled: 浩浩荡荡 'in a mighty stream'.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Three strokes on the left: something done with the hand.

chars.story: A hand pushes a thing over a little: move over.
A hand takes a little at a time from another's page: copy.
chars.note: Also 'search and seize': 抄家.

chars.story: Hands grabbing the riches of the capital: plunder.
chars.note: 掠过 also says something sweeps past, like a bird.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing on the left.

chars.story: A person who waits on the master's word: a servant.
chars.note: Traditional 僕 was more elaborate; 仆 keeps the person and one mark.

chars.story: A person gripping a long staff: off to battle.
chars.note: Also 'rely on': 依仗.

chars.story: A person pointing at himself: I, in northern speech.
chars.note: Northern dialect for 'I' and 'my'; you will meet it in dialogue.

chars.story: A person who waits at the temple gate to serve: attend.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 𠂇 roof-stroke + 矢 arrow
chars.story: A man trusted with the bow and arrow on the border: a marquis.
chars.note: Also the surname Hou.

chars.story: A person working in the same office as you: a colleague.
chars.note: In modern prose mostly 官僚 'bureaucrat'.

chars.story: Metal weights set beside the scales: the pound sterling.
chars.note: Almost only 英镑 'pound sterling'. Traditional 鎊.

chars.story: Metal hammered section by section: forged.
chars.note: 锻炼 is the everyday word: to train, work out. Traditional 鍛.

chars.story: A small metal hook dipped in the water: fishing.
chars.note: Traditional 釣.

chars.story: A bent piece of metal: a metal hook.
chars.note: Traditional 鉤.

chars.story: Thread wound round and round something: wind around.
chars.note: Traditional 纏.

chars.story: A treaty tied up with the emperor's silk cord: bound.
chars.note: Only in compounds like 缔结. Traditional 締.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: The speech radical on the left.

chars.story: Words stop and the teeth show in a gaping mouth: astounded.
chars.note: Traditional 訝: 言 became 讠.

chars.story: Words passed on in secret: a spy.
chars.note: Traditional 諜: 言 became 讠.

groups.title: dogs and monkeys 犭 犬

chars.parts: - 大 big with a dot for the ear
chars.story: A big shape with one dot for an ear: a dog.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'dog'. Same shape; modern speech says 狗, and 犬 shows up in compounds.

chars.story: An animal squeezed between two walls: narrow.
chars.note: Traditional 狹.

chars.story: A restless animal that hops like a lord's page boy: a monkey.
A small creature that lives below the water: shrimp.
chars.note: Traditional 蝦.

chars.story: A great coloured worm arching across the sky: a rainbow.
chars.note: Old belief saw the rainbow as a creature.

chars.story: A creature that piles turn on turn: a spiral shell.
A black bird with a sharp, ugly beak: a crow.
chars.note: Traditional 鴉: 鳥 became 鸟.

chars.story: The emperor's own bird: the phoenix.
chars.note: Only in 凤凰. 凤 is the male, 凰 the female.

chars.parts: - a swallow: head 廿, body 口, wings 北, forked tail 灬
chars.story: A bird with a small head, spread wings and a forked tail: a swallow bird.
chars.note: Also a surname and an old state, Yan, around Beijing.

chars.story: Grass left in a dim granary goes deep, dark green.
chars.note: In modern prose mostly 'pale' (苍白) and 'fly' (苍蝇). Traditional 蒼.

chars.story: Leafy plants grown to be eaten: vegetables.
A plant with tiny, delicate fronds: a fern.
chars.note: Mostly in flower names and girls' names.

chars.story: A twining vine that tangles anything near: kudzu.
chars.note: A surname too: 诸葛亮 Zhuge Liang.

chars.story: A plant's bud, ready to burst open like thunder: a flower bud.
A plant that climbs and clings: a vine.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: A tree on the left or below.

chars.story: A drooping tree beside the water: a willow.
chars.note: Also a surname, Liu.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 圭 jade tablet
chars.story: A tree with sweet flowers, precious as jade: cassia.
chars.note: 桂 is also the short name of Guangxi, as in 桂林.

chars.story: The great timber along the top of a house.
chars.note: It also counts buildings: 一栋楼. Traditional 棟.

chars.story: Wood left as it grew, uncarved: plain.
chars.note: A Korean surname too, Park. Traditional 樸.

groups.title: the body 月
groups.note: Flesh, and the parts of the body.

chars.story: The organ in the flesh that does the daily work: the liver.
chars.note: Slang 肝 also means grinding away at a game.

chars.story: Flesh puffed up tight as a drum: puff up.
The empty space inside the flesh: a cavity.
Flesh at the side of the body: the upper arm.
The stalk that holds the head up: the neck.
chars.note: Traditional 頸: 頁 became 页.

groups.title: sickness 疒
groups.note: A sickness frame round the left and top.

chars.parts: 疒 sickness + 叟 old man
chars.story: An old man worn down by sickness: he loses weight.
A sickness that stays and swells: a tumor.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth on the left: calls and noises.

chars.story: A mouth that jeers at you: mock.
A mouth opens as you suddenly see it: oh, I see.
chars.note: An interjection. It can also stand for a rooster's crow.

chars.story: A mouth calls out of the dark: hey!
chars.note: An interjection, or a chuckle.

chars.story: A guest clears his throat: coughing.
chars.note: Seen in place names and loanwords, such as 喀什 and 喀麦隆.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 兄 elder brother
chars.story: Mouths chanting over the elder brother: a curse.
Earth packed down firm to sit on: a pad.
chars.note: Traditional 墊. Also 'pay on someone's behalf': 垫付.

chars.story: The earth gives way beneath it: cave in.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 𠂇 + 土 earth
chars.story: A fall from the mound to the ground: degenerate.
chars.note: Traditional 墮 had a longer middle.

chars.story: A polished jade with its pattern showing, pink as a rose.
chars.note: Only in 玫瑰 'rose'.

chars.story: A strange, uncanny jade: semiprecious.
chars.note: In 玫瑰 'rose', and 瑰宝 'rare treasure'.

groups.title: cloth and cover
groups.note: Things that wrap, shield or hide.

chars.parts: - a cloth hanging from a cord
chars.story: A cloth hanging from a belt: a cloth.
chars.note: His Analects 巾 is the same shape; here it is the cloth radical too.

chars.story: Clothes for the very end of the leg: socks.
chars.note: Traditional 襪.

chars.parts: - a canopy held up on a pole
chars.story: A canopy held up on a pole: an umbrella.
chars.note: Traditional 傘, which was far busier.

chars.story: A crowd walks between you and the view: it covers it up.

groups.title: places and states
groups.note: Names you meet on maps and in history.

chars.parts: - a lid-like top over a grain shape, with a hooked foot
chars.story: The old Guangdong: the Cantonese.
chars.note: Short name for Guangdong. Traditional 粵.

chars.story: An elephant at ease in the plain: carefree.
chars.note: The word to know is 犹豫 'hesitate'. Also the short name of Henan.

chars.story: A tall gate-tower of the great state of Wei.
chars.note: A surname, and the name of a Warring States kingdom and a Three Kingdoms dynasty.

chars.story: The woman above you in the family: older sister.
chars.note: Common in Taiwan writing; 姐 is the usual form.

chars.story: A man takes a woman: he marries her.

chars.parts: 戊 weapon + 尗 small bean
chars.story: The old axe handed down through the clan: relatives.
chars.note: Also 'sorrow' in 悲戚; and a surname, Qi.

chars.story: Strength spent in service that rises like a cloud: meritorious.
chars.note: Traditional 勳.

chars.story: A clear mark that stands out: conspicuous.
chars.note: The name Zhanghua, 彰化, in Taiwan.

chars.story: Shells worth next to nothing: lowly.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'lowly'. 貝 became 贝 and 戔 became 戋.

chars.parts: 敝 worn + 廾 two hands
chars.story: Two hands wearing it to shreds: a drawback.
Those who are not honest, hiding in a box: bandits.
An axe laid across a cart: behead.
chars.note: Traditional 斬: 車 became 车.

chars.story: A knife under the roof of a house: butcher.
chars.note: Also 'rule over': 主宰, and an old minister: 宰相.

chars.story: A person caught and held: taken prisoner.

groups.title: materials and vessels
groups.note: Things made of earth, stone and metal.

chars.story: Fired earth shaped like stone: a brick.
chars.note: Traditional 磚.

chars.story: A pot you fill by pouring: a jar.
The storeroom of a boat: the cabin.
chars.note: Traditional 艙.

chars.parts: 山 hill + 厂 cliff + 火 fire
chars.story: Fire in a pit at the foot of a cliff: charcoal.
A head tipped over: toppled.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'topple'. Traditional 顛: 頁 became 页.

chars.story: Hand over hand, layer on layer: pile up.
chars.note: Traditional 疊, a far fuller shape.

chars.parts: 午 noon + 止 stop + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: The porter kneels and stops: he takes off his load.
A horse bolts all at once: abrupt.
chars.note: 步骤 is a 'step' in a procedure. Traditional 驟.

chars.story: Food handed to the animals you raise: rear.
chars.note: Traditional 飼: 食 became 饣.

chars.story: A jar left to ferment into a thick paste.
chars.note: Traditional 醬.

chars.story: A wrapped bundle of suns: ten days.
chars.note: The month has three: 上旬, 中旬, 下旬. Also age: 七旬 'in one's seventies'.

chars.parts: - cracks spreading from a centre line
chars.story: Cracks spread on a heated bone: an omen.
chars.note: Also 'million': 兆瓦 'megawatt'.

chars.parts: - a crack on an oracle bone
chars.story: A crack with one branch: read it and divine.
chars.note: In 萝卜 'radish' it is just part of the word.

chars.story: Reaching from dawn up to now: and, as well as.
chars.note: Formal 'and', as in 暨南大学.

chars.story: He walked on, and then at last it was done: finally.
chars.note: Literary 'then, so'. 未遂 'not carried out', as in 杀人未遂.

chars.story: A person goes back again and again: repeatedly.
chars.note: Traditional 屢.

chars.parts: - a sack tied at the top, with 衣 clothes at its foot
chars.story: A sack tied at the neck, full of things: a sack.
Work that makes a thing firm: make firm.
chars.note: Almost only in 巩固. Traditional 鞏.

chars.story: An eye that has come to harm: blind.
chars.note: Also 'groundlessly, for nothing': 瞎说. Spoken 'blind' (瞎子); 盲 is the written word (盲人).

chars.story: A small copy of the flesh: it resembles you.
chars.note: Also a surname, Xiao. Literary 'resemble'; today in 肖像 'portrait' and 生肖 'zodiac sign'.

chars.story: A masked figure with a big head looms: awe.
Bamboo slips bound in a bundle and sent: an invitation card.
chars.note: Today mostly in 请柬 and as the short form of Cambodia.

chars.parts: 尢 lame leg + 介 between
chars.story: Hobbling in between two sides: awkward.
chars.note: Appears only after 尴: 尴尬.

sentences.en: I need to take a shower.
I got hurt in the shoulder.
I am blind in the right eye.
The monkey climbed up a tree.

sentences.zh: 开罗的一栋大楼倒塌了。
请把淋湿的伞放到这个袋子里。
sentences.en: Put the wet umbrella in this bag, please.

sentences.zh: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。
sentences.en: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
